title: The four winds — the Hebrew says “I have spread you abroad”, the Greek says “I will gather you”
summary: The KJV says the LORD has spread his people abroad as the four winds of heaven. The Hebrew verb is פֵּרַשְׂתִּי. Brenton’s Greek reads συνάξω, “I will gather”, and continues “to Zion” in the next verse.

title: The stone with seven eyes — “I will engrave the graving thereof” in the Hebrew, “I am digging a trench” in the Greek
